messages:
Nina (Design): Quick microcopy pass for a few places in the Console before tomorrow's deploy. Two small things: the throughput/latency tooltip and the Rollouts empty state + Abort dialog.
Leo (Product): go for it, low risk. what's your thinking?
Nina (Design): Tooltip first: current reads "Avg latency vs throughput" which is sparse and confusing to new users. propose: `Latency (median) vs throughput (requests/sec)` with a short helper line when hovered: `Hover a point for sample size and 95% P50/P95 values.`
Priya (Eng): like the clarity. tiny nit: use consistent metric labels — we show P50, P95 elsewhere. maybe: `Latency (P50) vs throughput (req/sec)`?
Avery (Accessibility): keep spoken form clear for screen readers. Tooltips are tricky because they might not be keyboard focusable; ensure the chart points expose `aria-describedby` to a visible region. Also avoid abbreviations like `req/sec`. Spell `requests per second`.
Nina (Design): good call — update to: `Latency (P50) vs throughput (requests per second)` and tooltip body: `Hover a point to see sample size and latency at P50 and P95.`
Leo (Product): second item is Rollouts empty state. Current empty state: "No rollouts yet" with a button "Create". That's bland. Suggest heading: `No active rollouts` and body: `Test model updates safely with canary and gradual rollouts. Create your first rollout to try traffic splitting and automatic rollback.` Button copy: `Create rollout`.
Priya (Eng): can we shorten the body to avoid truncation on small widths? maybe split into two lines in UI. Also confirm `automatic rollback` is accurate — that's a policy feature in the next sprint.
Leo (Product): good catch. replace with: `Test model updates safely with canary and gradual rollouts. Create your first rollout to enable traffic splitting.` (drop auto rollback mention).
Nina (Design): updated. also added an illustration alt text: `Illustration: empty roadmap with a rocket` for a11y.
Avery (Accessibility): alt text fine. For the Create Rollout CTA, add `aria-describedby` to point to a short help text: `Rollouts split production traffic across pinned model versions.`
Priya (Eng): final item: Abort rollout confirmation dialog. Current copy: "Abort rollout?" with a small caption: "This will stop the rollout." Users reported confusion whether it reverts traffic instantly or waits.
Nina (Design): propose full dialog copy: heading `Abort rollout`, body `This will stop the active rollout and restore the previous traffic split immediately. Ongoing requests will finish; model artifacts remain intact. This action cannot be undone.` Secondary button `Cancel` primary danger `Abort rollout` and an additional inline note: `Tip: to pause without reverting, use the Pause action.`
Leo (Product): strong. Can we soften "cannot be undone" to "cannot be undone from the UI"? legal prefers clarity.
Nina (Design): changed to: `This action cannot be undone from the Console.`
Avery (Accessibility): ensure focus management lands on Cancel and the dialog has `role="alertdialog"` with `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`. Also make the inline tip keyboard reachable.
Priya (Eng): I'll wire the modal semantics and implement the text. Will also add telemetry event: `rollout_abort_confirmed`.
merge-bot: PR created by @priya: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/534 — includes tooltip label updates, Rollouts empty state copy + alt text, and Abort dialog copy and a11y hooks.
Nina (Design): thank you! i'll review and run a quick copy QA in staging. :sparkles:
Leo (Product): noted for the release blurb: "UI copy improvements for charts and rollouts to reduce ambiguity."
Nina (Design): closing thread after PR review. :white_check_mark:
